model_gaps: Taking the cross and resolving to go to Jerusalem is a vow with no act type in the scheme and lies outside the kinship, economic and legal scope; abstained.

'die Rechte' are unspecified; RightShape requires a crm:P2_has_type from rv:RightTypes and the scheme has no generic right concept, so only 'Besitzungen' is recorded as rf:concerns (as crm:E18_Physical_Thing, although Besitzungen need not be a single physical thing).
No class for an office as the object of an appointment; the offices 'Erzbischof von Mainz' and 'Bischof von Eichstätt' are kept only as rf:qualifier.
No act type for holding a court assembly ('Hoftag'); kept only as a second evidence selector of Arnold's appointment.
Konrad's appointment is passive and names no appointing actor; no grantor reference is inferred.
The regest names no claimant or respondent in 'Streit zwischen', so both parties are rv:Participant; the losing party of the judgment is not referenced.
The ruler's presence ('Vor König Friedrich') has no specific role; recorded as rv:Participant of the judgment.
rf:refersToAct is used from the judgment to the dispute it decides, which stretches its definition (later confirmation or assurance).
The formulaic list of local witnesses ('Nennung lokaler Zeugen') is skipped per guidelines.
